samples.summary: Design doc still documents the per-lane table the reporter no longer renders
samples.evidence: `docs/design/harness-engineering.md:596-599` — "`.github/workflows/ci-report.yml` leads the PR comment with the same reasons … Filtered lanes render as `⊘` and skipped-after-failure as `⏭️`, because collapsing the two would let a real failure read as a deliberate omission." Both glyph paths lived only in the deleted `<details>Per-lane detail</details>` table in `ci-report.yml`; after this change `⏭️` exists nowhere in the repo (`grep '⏭'` matches only this doc and `docs/tasks/active/20260812-path-aware-ci-todo.md:74`) and `⊘` survives only in `scripts/verify-self.mjs:742` console output. The same section at lines 352-356 still explains that "lane names come from the PR's own `scripts/verify-self.mjs`" and are collapsed to stop forged table rows — the new comment interpolates no lane names at all. The doc is also now internally inconsistent with its own line 308-314, which describes the scope-only comment.

samples.summary: `ci.yml`'s comment and the doc's "a reduced run must not hide that it was reduced" no longer hold for a `full:false, heavy:true` run
samples.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:107-111 states the run summary is duplicated because "`ci-report.yml` renders the same reasons onto the pull request". After this change the reasons from `ci-context/areas.json` are pushed only inside the `skipped.length > 0` branch (`ci-report.yml:335-339`). A resolution with `full:false, heavy:true` (any workspace-package change — the reasons and lane filtering are real, but neither heavy job is skipped) now falls into the `else` branch and posts "### Full CI / No job was skipped" with no reasons, and the gating-file branch (`ci-report.yml:322`) also suppresses them. That contradicts the out-of-diff claim here and weakens `docs/design/harness-engineering.md:594-597` ("A reduced run must not hide that it was reduced") for that case; only the untitled `Lanes: … filtered` line hints at it.

samples.summary: The new read/write split guard enumerates only 3 of the resolve step's privileged reads, so two of them can be moved onto the App token without failing the test
samples.evidence: The `READS` list at `scripts/test/ci-workflow.test.mjs:312-316` covers `actions.listJobsForWorkflowRun`, `pulls.listFiles` and `repos.getContent`. The resolve step also calls `github.rest.repos.listPullRequestsAssociatedWithCommit` (`.github/workflows/ci-report.yml:122`) and `github.rest.pulls.get` (`.github/workflows/ci-report.yml:143`), both of which need `pull-requests`/`contents: read` that the App token (`permission-issues: write` only) does not hold. Moving either into the write step — the natural refactor, since `pulls.get` is what gates the write — would pass this guard and, per the test's own comment, only 403 on a private fork, silently killing the report. Fix belongs on the new test: add those two endpoints to `READS`.
searchedFor: grep -rn 'ci-report' scripts/ .github/ docs/ (no other guard on this split)
grep -rn 'workflows' scripts/verify-ci.mjs (no workflow structural checks there)
